plugin.name: enne_bloot
plugin.author: enne
plugin.purpose: type bloot polished to see its level (1-21)

muclient.script:
local count=21 -- Don't look at me, blame table.getn! local bloot={ [1]="polished", [2]="enhanced", [3]="burnished", [4]="shiny", [5]="vibrant", [6]="sparkling", [7]="gleaming", [8]="shimmering", [9]="dazzling", [10]="brilliant", [11]="radiant", [12]="wondrous", [13]="majestic", [14]="exalted", [15]="eternal", [16]="legendary", [17]="epic", [18]="mythical", [19]="fabled", [20]="divine", [21]="godly" } local colors={ ["polished"]="Green", ["enhanced"]="Green", ["burnished"]="Green", ["shiny"]="Green", ["vibrant"]="Green", ["sparkling"]="Green", ["gleaming"]="Green", ["shimmering"]="Green", ["dazzling"]="Green", ["brilliant"]="Green", ["radiant"]="Red", ["wondrous"]="Red", ["majestic"]="Red", ["exalted"]="Red", ["eternal"]="Red", ["legendary"]="Yellow", ["epic"]="Yellow", ["mythical"]="Yellow", ["fabled"]="Yellow", ["divine"]="Yellow", ["godly"]="White" }
function OnPluginInstall() help() end-- func
function help() Note("Bloot by Enne. Type e.g., bloot polished to see its bonus loot level. Type bloot list for the list of all bonus loot flag names, levels, and colors, you can also type bloot list <color> to list only bonus loot flags of a specific color, bloot report <channel> or bloot vireport <channel> to report all to a channel, and type bloot help for help. Note that you can also type incomplete names like bloot god for godly.") end-- func
function blootlevel(name, line, val) if val[1]=="" then return end-- if val[1]=string.lower(val[1]) if val[1]=="help" then return help() end-- if
if val[1]=="list" then for k, v in pairs(bloot) do if val[2]~="" then if string.lower(colors[v])==string.lower(val[2]) then Note(v.." "..k.." "..colors[v]) end-- if else Note(v.." "..k.." "..colors[v]) end-- if end-- for return end-- if
if (val[1]=="report" or val[1]=="vireport") and val[2]~=nil then local tmp="" for k, v in pairs (bloot) do if val[1]=="report" then if v~="godly" then tmp=tmp.."@"..string.sub(colors[v], 1, 1).."(@W"..v.."@"..string.sub(colors[v], 1, 1)..")@W, " else tmp=tmp.."@"..string.sub(colors[v], 1, 1).."(@R"..v.."@"..string.sub(colors[v], 1, 1).."), " end-- if else tmp=tmp..v..": "..colors[v]..", " end-- if end-- for Send(val[2].." "..string.sub(tmp, 1, string.len(tmp)-2)) return end-- if
local found=-1 for k, v in pairs (bloot) do if string.find(v, "^"..val[1]..".*$")~=nil then found=k break end-- if end-- for if found==-1 then return Note("Not found.") end-- if Note("Level "..found.."/"..count.." "..bloot[found].." ("..colors[bloot[found]]..")") end-- func
